looks.label: 현재 · 단발과 안경
identityInstructions: She is an adult Korean woman with short softly wavy brown hair and thin round glasses.
Give her large calm amber-brown eyes, a soft oval face, a small nose, soft full lips, and subtle smile lines at the outer corners of her eyes.
Keep her build naturally curvy, healthy, and elegant.
outfitInstructions: Dress her in a long olive-green cardigan, a faded cream cotton blouse, and a long brown A-line skirt.
Give her a book with one plain bookmark.
characterUndesiredInstructions: A teenage appearance, an idol outfit, glamorous makeup, or a seductive pose.

situations.label: 현재 기본 모습
situations.description: 짧은 머리와 안경, 실용적인 옷차림의 현재 모습입니다.
instructions: Hold the book close to her body with a guarded posture and glance toward the doorway.

situations.label: 조용히 출입문 확인
situations.description: 자신의 안전을 확인하며 대화를 이어 갑니다.
instructions: Hold the book close to her body with a guarded posture and glance toward the room entrance.

situations.label: 자기 문장으로 진술
situations.description: 현재의 삶을 지키며 과거 사건을 기록합니다.
instructions: Hold an old postcard with its address removed and maintain a steady direct gaze in an upright seated posture.

looks.label: 과거 · 서점 근무
identityInstructions: She is an adult Korean woman with naturally wavy shoulder-length brown hair and no eyewear.
Give her large calm amber-brown eyes, a soft oval face, a small nose, soft full lips, and subtle smile lines at the outer corners of her eyes.
Keep her build naturally curvy, healthy, and elegant.
outfitInstructions: Dress her in an olive cardigan, a faded cream cotton shirt, and a long brown skirt.
Give her an old independent-bookstore name tag, a book, and one plain bookmark.
characterUndesiredInstructions: A teenage appearance, an idol outfit, or glamorous makeup.

situations.label: 서점 손님 응대
situations.description: 모든 손님에게 제공하는 따뜻한 업무 표정입니다.
instructions: Hold the book at waist level with a relaxed professional posture and a polite closed-mouth smile toward a customer outside the frame.

situations.label: 반복 방문 뒤 경계
situations.description: 책을 품에 안고 출입문과 동료를 확인합니다.
instructions: Hold the book close to her body with a guarded posture and glance toward the shop entrance.

situations.label: 주관 화면 · 첫사랑 기억
situations.description: 손님 응대 친절을 자신만을 향한 첫사랑처럼 재구성한 화면입니다.
instructions: Hold the book against her chest with soft eyes, a warm gentle smile, and a nostalgic pose.
